description: This file defines a server-side load function for a logout page in a SvelteKit project. It clears authentication cookies and session data, then redirects the user to the login page. The file appears to be migrated from Prisma to Django REST API, as noted in comments.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Handles the server-side logic for the logout page: clearing cookies and session data, then redirecting to '/login'.
